steps.text: Maria says, "I'm just looking." Is the call over? No! This is an **objection**. An objection is a reason to say "not now".
Most objections mean "Please do not push me." So smile, slow down, and use **3 steps**.

cards.back: Ask one easy question about the home or the timing.
Offer two times with the agent.

steps.sub: Three steps fix almost every objection.

options.text: OK. Sorry to bother you. Bye!
options.why: Do not give up so fast. Most leads start this way.

options.text: This home will sell fast. Decide today.
options.why: That is pushing. Pushing ends calls.

options.text: Totally fine! Most people look early. Which area do you like most?
options.why: You acknowledge. Then you ask an easy question.

steps.line: Totally fine! Most people look early. Which area do you like most?

options.text: Understood. Did you sign an agreement with them?
options.why: This one question tells you what to do next.

options.text: Our agent is better. Give us a try.
options.why: Never say bad things about another agent.
Ask about a signed agreement first.

steps.q: She says, "Yes, we signed." What now?
options: Say "Great, I'll make a note." Then tell your agent.
steps.why: A signed agreement is a promise. Respect it.

steps.q: She says, "No, nothing signed." What now?
options: Say goodbye and end the call
Tell her to drop the other agent
Offer a short call with your agent. Give two times.
steps.why: With no agreement, she can still talk to your agent.

steps.text: Signed with an agent? Respect it. Tell your agent.
steps.sub: It is fair. It protects your client.

options.text: Sure. I will email it. Bye!
options.why: You sent info but have no next step.

options.text: I will send it right now! Are you free Saturday morning or afternoon to see it?
options.why: Say yes. Then ask for the appointment.

options.text: This takes one minute. Please listen.
options.why: She said she is busy. Respect that.

options.text: OK. I will call you some time.
No problem. Is today at 6 or tomorrow at noon better?
options.why: Two choices turn "later" into a real time.

steps.text: Call back at that **exact** time. Set a task in Follow Up Boss. Then you never forget.

steps.says: Wait. Is this a sales call?

options.why: Never say you are the agent. It is not true.

options.text: I'm Ana, an assistant with Rivera Home Team. You asked about 12 Oak Street.
options.why: Honest and clear. You say who you are and why.

options.text: No, it is only a short survey.
options.why: Never lie. One lie breaks all trust.

options.text: Rates are low. You should buy now.
options.why: That is loan advice. You never give it.

options.text: Great question for your agent. Daniel can get you real numbers. Thursday at 5 or Saturday at 10?
options.why: Rates are the cost of a loan. The agent or their lender helps.

items.text: Did you sign an agreement with them?
Buy now before prices go up.

steps.text: Use the 3 steps up to **two times** on one call. A third "no"? Thank them. Ask for a good day to call back.

steps.q: Maria says "no" a third time. What do you do?
options: Thank her and set a day to call back
steps.why: Respect wins. A happy lead answers your next call.

options.text: Can I ask just one question first?
I'm sorry. I will remove your number now. Have a good day.
options.why: Then tag the lead DNC. Never delete the lead.

steps.text: "Stop" is not an objection. Just stop.
steps.sub: Say sorry and tag the lead DNC.

steps.text: Nice! Now you know what to say when a lead says "no".

quiz.q: What are the 3 steps for an objection?
quiz.explain: Acknowledge, ask, then offer two times.

quiz.q: "I already have an agent." What do you ask first?
options: Did you sign an agreement with them?
quiz.explain: If they signed, respect it and tell your agent.

quiz.q: "Just send me info." What is the best reply?
options: Send it and end the call
Say no, a meeting is better
Say yes, then offer two times to see the home
quiz.explain: Send the info. Ask for the appointment too.

quiz.q: "What are rates right now?" What do you do?
options: Say the agent can get real numbers, then offer two times
quiz.explain: You never give loan advice. The agent or their lender helps.

quiz.q: "Stop calling me!" What do you do?
options: Say sorry, stop and tag DNC
quiz.explain: Stop is not an objection. Never argue.
